001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.Variable;
009import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.delta.IIntDeltaMonitor;
010import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.delta.ISetDeltaMonitor;
011import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.IntEventType;
012import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.SetEventType;
013import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
014import org.chocosolver.util.objects.setDataStructures.ISetIterator;
015import org.chocosolver.util.procedure.IntProcedure;
016import org.clafer.common.Util;
017
018/**
019 *
020 * @author jimmy
021 */
022public class PropArrayToSet extends Propagator<Variable> {
023
024    private final IntVar[] as;
025    private final IIntDeltaMonitor[] asD;
026    private final SetVar s;
027    private final ISetDeltaMonitor sD;
028
029    public PropArrayToSet(IntVar[] as, SetVar s) {
030        super(buildArray(as, s), PropagatorPriority.TERNARY, true);
031        if (as.length == 0) {
032            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
033        }
034        this.as = as;
035        this.asD = PropUtil.monitorDeltas(as, this);
036        this.s = s;
037        this.sD = s.monitorDelta(this);
038    }
039
040    private static Variable[] buildArray(IntVar[] as, SetVar s) {
041        Variable[] array = new Variable[as.length + 1];
042        array[0] = s;
043        System.arraycopy(as, 0, array, 1, as.length);
044        return array;
045    }
046
047    private boolean isAVar(int idx) {
048        return idx >= 1;
049    }
050
051    private int getAVarIndex(int idx) {
052        assert isAVar(idx);
053        return idx - 1;
054    }
055
056    private boolean isSVar(int idx) {
057        return idx == 0;
058    }
059
060    @Override
061    public int getPropagationConditions(int vIdx) {
062        if (isAVar(vIdx)) {
063            return IntEventType.all();
064        }
065        assert isSVar(vIdx);
066        return SetEventType.all();
067    }
068
069    private boolean findMate(int sEnv) throws ContradictionException {
070        assert s.getUB().contains(sEnv);
071        boolean inKer = s.getLB().contains(sEnv);
072        int mate = -1;
073        for (int i = 0; i < as.length; i++) {
074            if (as[i].contains(sEnv)) {
075                // Found a second mate.
076                if (mate != -1 || !inKer) {
077                    mate = -2;
078                    break;
079                }
080                mate = i;
081            }
082        }
083        if (mate == -1) {
084            // No mates.
085            s.remove(sEnv, this);
086        } else if (mate != -2 && inKer) {
087            // One mate.
088            return as[mate].instantiateTo(sEnv, this);
089        }
090        return false;
091    }
092
093    private void findMates() throws ContradictionException {
094        ISetIterator iter = s.getUB().iterator();
095        while (iter.hasNext()) {
096            int i = iter.nextInt();
097            if (findMate(i)) {
098                findMates();
099                return;
100            }
101        }
102    }
103
104    @Override
105    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
106        // Prune as
107        for (IntVar a : as) {
108            PropUtil.domSubsetEnv(a, s, this);
109        }
110        // Prune s
111        findMates();
112        // Pick s
113        for (IntVar a : as) {
114            if (a.isInstantiated()) {
115                s.force(a.getValue(), this);
116            }
117        }
118        PropUtil.startMonitoring(asD);
119        sD.startMonitoring();
120    }
121
122    @Override
123    public void propagate(int idxVarInProp, int mask) throws ContradictionException {
124        if (isSVar(idxVarInProp)) {
125            sD.forEach(sEnv -> {
126                for (IntVar a : as) {
127                    if (a.removeValue(sEnv, this) && a.isInstantiated()) {
128                        s.force(a.getValue(), this);
129                    }
130                }
131            }, SetEventType.REMOVE_FROM_ENVELOPE);
132            sD.forEach(sKer -> {
133                if (findMate(sKer)) {
134                    findMates();
135                }
136            }, SetEventType.ADD_TO_KER);
137        } else {
138            assert isAVar(idxVarInProp);
139
140            int id = getAVarIndex(idxVarInProp);
141            if (IntEventType.isRemove(mask)
142                    || IntEventType.isInclow(mask) && as[id].getLB() > s.getUB().min()
143                    || IntEventType.isDecupp(mask) || IntEventType.isInstantiate(mask)) {
144                asD[id].forEachRemVal((IntProcedure) aRem -> {
145                    if (s.getUB().contains(aRem)) {
146                        if (findMate(aRem)) {
147                            findMates();
148                        }
149                    }
150                });
151            }
152            if (as[id].isInstantiated()) {
153                s.force(as[id].getValue(), this);
154            }
155        }
156    }
157
158    @Override
159    public ESat isEntailed() {
160        if (s.getLB().size() > as.length) {
161            return ESat.FALSE;
162        }
163        for (IntVar a : as) {
164            if (!PropUtil.isDomIntersectEnv(a, s)) {
165                return ESat.FALSE;
166            }
167        }
168        ISetIterator iter = s.getLB().iterator();
169        while (iter.hasNext()) {
170            int i = iter.nextInt();
171            if (!PropUtil.domsContain(as, i)) {
172                return ESat.FALSE;
173            }
174        }
175        return isCompletelyInstantiated() ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
176    }
177
178    @Override
179    public String toString() {
180        return "arrayToSet({" + Util.commaSeparate(as) + "} = " + s + ")";
181    }
182}
